analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 후 반등했으나 50 이상으로 회복하지 못하고 다시 하락. MACD 히스토그램은 양수에서 음수로 전환 후 악화 지속. ADX 30.6로 추세는 뚜렷하나 -DI가 +DI보다 우위인 약세 흐름. 5일 연속 양봉 후 음봉 출현으로 매수세 약화 확인.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI entered oversold territory and bounced but failed to recover above 50 and is now declining again. MACD histogram turned from positive to negative and continues to worsen. ADX at 30.6 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, showing a bearish flow. After 5 consecutive days of positive candles, a negative candle appeared, confirming weakening buying pressure.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($58,435) vs SMA5 ($59,912)/SMA20 ($68,848)/SMA50 ($91,834): Below short-term and mid-term trends, confirming bearish position.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($115,456)/SMA200 ($113,047): Continued weakening of long-term trend.
· 52-week position (9.6%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.9→35.2): Entered oversold territory, confirmed failure to rebound and renewed decline.
· MACD histogram trajectory (921.3269→-609.9491): Bearish expansion and weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $54,195): Approaching lower band, band width at 42.57% indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($41,000): Below Pivot S1 ($44,235), indicating potential for further decline.
· Swing resistance level ($80,380): High level relative to current price, breakthrough would signal bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Higher Low unconfirmed, suggesting potential for Lower High.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x): Contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Downtrend continues, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.

MACD histogram continues to worsen, falling to -609.9491, confirming selling pressure dominance.
ADX at 30.6 indicates a clear trend, but -DI dominance maintains a bearish flow.
